unlisted_practices: Fine-tuning a vision-language model on simulated multi-agent Socratic teaching dialogues to improve one-to-many clinical education
Explicit internal thinking mechanism modeling individual student belief states and group consensus

screen.reason: Evaluates ClinTutor-R1, a multimodal agentic model for clinical Socratic education, through simulation and a 200-participant user study; however, it develops and tests a new system/agent architecture rather than testing an organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
